items.description: Reciprocal sidecar linking mutates an active parent record without updating updated_at.
items.evidence: src/specle/sidecars.py:38-53 writes both status.json records, but neither updated payload receives current Unix-second updated_at.
items.analysis: Lifecycle policy requires an activated active record to write updated_at whenever its durable status record changes. The new parent-side relationship is required for joint delivery, so omitting the timestamp leaves its handoff state stale even though the relationship changed.
items.recommendation: Have the reciprocal-link mutation write updated_at on every activated active record it changes, and cover that timestamp behaviour in the production test.
items.rationale: updated_at records lifecycle status changes only. Reciprocal relationship linking changes delivery metadata and does not change lifecycle status.
